articles.title: Raspberry Sugar Found in Space! Could It Be a Clue to How Life Began?
articles.summary: Scientists just found a sugar called erythrulose in a dusty cloud near the center of our galaxy. It's the same sugar that gives raspberries their flavor — and it might help explain how life started on Earth.

articles.title: School-Bus-Sized Whale Sharks Spotted Off Florida — and They're Gentle Giants!
articles.summary: Scientists in Florida just filmed whale sharks — the biggest fish in the ocean — swimming near the Dry Tortugas. These gentle filter-feeders can grow up to 60 feet long, about the length of a bowling lane.

articles.title: A Mummy With a Secret: Ancient Egyptian Held a Page from Homer's Iliad!
articles.summary: Archaeologists in Egypt found a 1,600-year-old mummy with a papyrus tucked on its belly. The text? A famous part of Homer's Iliad — the first time a Greek story was used in mummification.
